summary:
# NOTES: "The Meddler" by W. C. Tuttle (Adventure, Dec 1 1927; Gutenberg #79212)

## Core cast
- **Hashknife Hartley** (Henry Hartley): tall, long serious face, gray eyes, wide mouth; leader; logical, lies cheerfully; detective for cattle association (revealed at end). Milk River, Montana origin; father a minister.
- **Sleepy Stevens** (David Stevens): broad-shouldered, square jaw, blocky face, merry wrinkles, blue eyes; nicknamed for seeming always awake; gets shot at B Arrow.
- **Tex Blanco** (Bryan Blanco): owner of B Arrow; Spanish father, Irish mother; flame/vermilion/blue silk shirts, silver chaps, pearl-handled .45; sorrel horse; sings "Irish Rose" song; mother Mrs. Blanco (Mary Bryan, from Wexford, pipe smoker, white hair).
- **Marion Evans**: new Pineville schoolteacher from Chicago (via Cheyenne); brown eyes; brother Blaine Evans (= Buck Dennig), left home at 14 after robbery suspicion. Fired and replaced by Mr. Long.
- **Buck Dennig** (= Blaine Evans): TD co-owner, murdered behind Stormy River Saloon; 10,000 drawn from bank.
- **Cleve Tolman**: TD co-owner, tall-ish, square jaw, gambler; killed by Luke Jones in Pineville street.
- **Pat Lynch**: sheriff, small wiry sharp-faced, graying; says "Yea-a-ah", "shore".
- **Oscar Johnson**: deputy, tall, sad-faced, black clothes, new black suit, "Swede" deputy; ruins buggy; swaps gun handles.
- **Mort Heffner**: prosecuting attorney, sallow, pouched eyes, celluloid collar.
- **Windy March**: stage driver; thin, tanned; named after fight story; carries Marion; held up by two men.
- **Ma (Gladys) Cooper**: fat, lives with Hootie; calls self "shucked Gladys"; rose bushes "twelve apostles".
- **Hootie Cooper**: merchant, thin, huge nose, squeaky voice; rival to Lester Cline (kerosene); school trustee; brother Jim Cooper of Mizpah, Arizona.
- **Sam Hall**: blacksmith, nasal; trustee; daughter Annie Hall (dance with Oscar; buggy crash).
- **Henry (Hennery) Goff**: postmaster, trustee.
- **Old Man Beebee**: trustee, bald, sour; wife Mrs. Beebee; kids Joe and Mary Beebee.
- **Mrs. Hall**: large, grim, artificial-wheat hat; Ella Hall (tattletale, Sam's daughter? — described as "Ella Hall, who lived next door to Beebee"; her "pa was a trustee").
- **Shorty Gallup**: TD foreman (appointed by Tolman); ~35, 5'6", crooked nose, pale eyes, missing two front teeth after fight with Frank Judd.
- **Matt Sturgis**: TD cowboy, Shorty's bunkie, tall thin; confesses; related to Shearer.
- **Alex McLean**: TD cowboy; black mustache; brother sick at Wallgate.
- **Eddie Grimes**: TD cowboy; quits; blue eyes.
- **Luke Jones**: TD cook, old; prune whisky; yodels; fired; shoots Tolman in Garnet and Pineville.
- **Bud Hough, Dobe Severn**: TD cowboys; Bud Hough at poker game; Dobe runs for coroner; leave for XOX.
- **Frank Judd**: B Arrow right-hand man; fought Shorty; "Tommy Corbett", **Kit Carson** (B Arrow hands); Andy Hastings (B Arrow, son Jimmy Hastings, age ~6, freckled).
- **Guy Shearer**: Pineville bank cashier, glasses, ~40; murdered in bank.
- **John Rice**: bank president, small, gray, slightly crippled.
- **Frank Shell**: gambler/owner Stormy River Saloon.
- **Lester Cline**: merchant; Annie Hall's dance partner.
- **Dr. Brent**: old cow-town doctor.
- **Sears**: cattle association detective (slender, ~40); warned out; "Sears is a clerk".
- **Ed Billings**: XOX owner; buyer of TD (deal halted).
- **Mr. Long**: replacement teacher, from Garnet.

## Events in order
1. Sunday dawn, Pineville. Oscar, in black suit, reports wrecked buggy (Annie Hall aboard; culvert crash). Pat finds Buck Dennig dead behind corral near Stormy River Saloon; skull smashed from behind; sorrel horse tied at corral.
2. Poker game witnesses (Hootie, Shell, Heffner, Cline, Severn, Hough). Buck and Tex quarreled over accused stolen card. Tex left ~1 a.m.; Buck left ~1:45 (Hootie: "quarter of two"). Buck had $165 on body; Heffner says Buck had roll of bills with rubber band.
3. Coroner (old doctor) examines. Tolman in kitchen with Shorty; TD crew learns news. Shorty suggests Blanco. Luke insults Shorty.
4. Tex meets Pat in street; Shearer reveals Buck drew $10,000 check day before. Pat tells Tolman. Tolman asks about Buck's quarrels.
5. Marion Evans arrives by stage with Windy (week after murder, mid-September). Windy's stories: "Windy" name from fight; schoolhouse cordwood prank. Tex at gate with package (pearl-handled guns from Colt Co.). Hootie/Mrs. Cooper welcome.
6. Shorty appointed foreman; Shorty fights Frank Judd at Stormy River Saloon; Oscar takes guns (shells removed). Shorty's gun back via Tolman; Tolman leaves with Shorty.
7. School opens Monday. Sam Hall's cat problem (answer 72 per Hootie; 448 wrong). Tex brings Jimmy Hastings (bet $50 with Hastings). Tex comes to school twice daily; trustees object.
8. Sears arrives; questioned by Tolman; threat letter "We will give you eight hours to leave this valley.—THE BUNCH." Sears leaves on stage; B in "Bunch" matches Tex's signature.
9. Beebee children withdrawn; Tex tells Marion he's "stop[ping]" visits; Shorty fights/whipped by? (Eddie Grimes later.)
10. Hootie resigns trustee; trustees meet at Sam Hall's. Trustees wait at school; Tex doesn't come.
11. Garnet dance; Marion goes to Garnet with Ma Cooper; stage holdup near mesa (rope across road); Marion finds Tex's pearl-handled gun; Ma Cooper and Marion conceal it in trunk.
12. Sheriff and Oscar find tracks; Andy shows Tex with head injury, bloody neckerchief.
13. Eddie and Shorty fight at TD corral; Eddie quits; Hashknife and Sleepy (Piney Lake claim) arrive; Hashknife invited to Cooper supper; sheriff confronts Ma Cooper about tracks.
14. Hashknife lies (Jim Cooper, Mizpah); wired; "Never knew anybody by the name of Hashknife Hartley." Threat letter to Hashknife; Sheriff reveals B in Bunch matches.
15. Marion tells Tex (on porch) she found his gun; Hashknife overhears.
16. Shearer found dead in bank; bank vault cleaned out ($25,000); hondo with B Arrow brand found by Hashknife.
17. Trustees dismiss Marion; Jimmy typhoid; Marion goes to B Arrow; Tex sings "Mother Machree"/"Irish Rose".
18. Oscar loses trunk in river, swaps pearl-handle gun for his own, scratching "O. J." on trigger guard; sheriff confronts Marion; Tex fights Oscar, gets shot; Sleepy shot (Hashknife carries him).
19. Hashknife at Garnet; Luke Jones shot by Tolman; Luke says Tolman (with Buck) quarreled over money, Buck had relatives (Marion).
20. Marion's brother = Buck Dennig revealed by photo.
21. Billings buying TD; Marion stops sale; Tolman shoots Luke; Tolman killed.
22. Shorty and Matt confess: Shorty killed Buck; Shearer forged check; they killed Shearer; money hidden at TD. Hashknife = cattle association detective.

## Key objects/numbers
- $10,000 check, $165 on body, $25,000 bank vault, $3,000 stage, $38,000 total.
- Pearl-handled .45 Colt (Tex's), Oscar's old gun with "O. J." scratched on trigger guard.
- Hondo marked B with arrow.
- Buggy $160 (Cheyenne).
- Hootie's store; Stormy River Saloon; B Arrow; TD ranch (5 mi SW on Lobo Creek).
